title: Swap confirmation shows the typed amount
summary: After typing 0.5 into the You pay field and clicking Review swap, the confirmation line reads "You pay 0.5 ETH".
what_differs: The broken page divides the typed amount by ten, so the confirmation reads "You pay 0.05 ETH".
